scope: Require full physical bounded-body consumption before the ACSH_SWEEP_CLASS/ACSH_EXTRUSION_CLASS action-body prefix status can be Complete; retain partial fields for tolerant inspection.

authority.oda: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.41 documents the 3DSOLID/REGION History ID carrier but does not define the proprietary Sweep action-body fields.
authority.peerReference: The local LibreDWG 0.14 dwg2.spec and minJSON expose candidate fields but are not normative; the selected real sample leaves 2,568 bits unknown in LibreDWG and its tail numeric values are not treated as semantic evidence.

source.kind: existing local public-source AC1027 DWG used as a read-only diagnostic; not a repository fixture

implementation.production: DRW_AssociativePrefixStatus::fromBoundedBody() returns Complete only when decode succeeded and cursorBit equals bodyEndBit; the Sweep/Extrusion prefix parser uses it after bounded reads.
implementation.generatedControl: tests/hardening_tests.cpp --acsh-action-body-exact-span verifies exact-end completion, an unparsed suffix, overrun, and decode failure.
implementation.physicalProbe: tests/ac1027_acds_source_probe.cpp reports class prefix status, source start bit and consumed bit span.

physicalProbe.result: ACSH_PREFIX 2e2 kind=7 status=Complete startBit=40 size=82; kind=8 status=Complete startBit=122 size=106; kind=9 status=Partial startBit=228 size=174.

limitations: The fix prevents a partial Sweep body from being labeled Complete; it does not decode the remaining 2,397 body bits or establish field semantics.
No ACSH_SWEEP_CLASS DWG-to-DXF writer route or role conversion is qualified; the selected profile remains output-refused.
No producer-wide or independent native semantic support claim is established.
nextAction: Continue with source-backed Sweep field/span research only where an authoritative or independently captured boundary exists; do not infer the skipped action-body tail or promote output support.
